description: Checks that a start time from check_availability is still free and returns `confirm_url`: the zhannett.com page where the customer signs in, sees the price and prepayment, and books by paying the prepayment. Nothing is booked or held until they do. Works without sign-in.

group_size.description: single, small (up to 4) or large (more than 4); needed when the experience offers more than one.

guests.description: How many people come. Where the price is per guest, the total and what is paid after the walk are computed from it.

locale.description: Language of the texts: ru, en or pt (default en).
